title: Calibration provided via syringe icon doesn't reset calibration timer.
body: When resolving a calibration error (in this case insufficient calibration) using the syringe icon, when the calibration is accepted by the transmitter the timer for regular calibrations doesn't get reset.  I have 12hr calibrations and apparently need to enter it via the menu calibration option to have timer reset.

comments.body: I'm not sure that adding measure from syringe icon actually does anything. In my case seems it doesn't. Haven't found any documentation for it, but I think it should be done from the calibration menu (unfortunately it gives errors for G6).
I think this issue should be resolved in the 26th May nightly.
